description: This file defines a 'Bulk' struct and associated methods for managing bulk operations with OpenSearch, including indexing, deleting, flushing, and periodic flushing of requests.

classes.name: Bulk
classes.description: A struct for managing bulk operations with OpenSearch, including request buffering, flushing, and periodic flushing.

methods.name: NewBulk
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Bulk instance with specified settings, client, timeout, and logger.

methods.name: IndexOp
methods.description: Adds an index operation with a document to the bulk request buffer.

methods.name: DeleteOp
methods.description: Adds a delete operation to the bulk request buffer.

methods.name: flushIfNecessary
methods.description: Checks if the buffer or request count exceeds thresholds and flushes if needed.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the bulk processor, flushing remaining requests and stopping the periodic flusher if active.

methods.name: periodicFlusher
methods.description: Runs periodically to flush the buffer based on the flush interval.

methods.name: _flush
methods.description: Performs the actual flush of buffered requests to OpenSearch.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Public method to flush the buffer immediately.
